notes_for_reviewer: Official isd.pku.edu.cn pages read 2026-10-06. Undergraduate tuition RMB 26,000 per year (humanities) and 30,000 (science) comes from the "Academic Guidance" page (no academic year stated, confidence medium); the 2026 admission notices say the tuition for the new intake "will be announced after approval". HSK level 6 with score 210 or higher is the standard Chinese requirement (alternatives for IB/A-level students: not encoded); the programme is taught in Chinese. Application fee RMB 800. 2026 rounds were 19 Dec 2025 - 28 Feb 2026 and 12 Jun - 10 Jul 2026 (written-exam route 1 Jan - 28 Feb 2026): they have passed and the 2027 dates are not published yet, so deadlines are empty. 4-6 years duration is quoted on the site; 4 years used. These two cards are generic: PKU lists 137 majors but the pages I read did not name them, so no ISCED-F field is set (the field match will be skipped). I did not invent majors.
